title: Find the Derangement of An Array
summary: Determine the count of derangements for an array of n integers from 1 to n, where no integer remains in its original position.
statement: Determine the count of derangements for an array of n integers from 1 to n, where no integer remains in its original position. Return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Count permutations in which no value remains in its original position; return modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Place the first value elsewhere, then distinguish whether that displaced value returns to position one.
Start with D(0)=1 and D(1)=0; roll the recurrence through n modulo the limit.
The two cases correspond to closing a two-cycle or leaving the displaced position for a larger derangement.
editorial: The two cases correspond to closing a two-cycle or leaving the displaced position for a larger derangement.

tests.explanation: Only [2,1] moves both values away from their original positions.
